suggested_tests.description: Ensure cache_dir returns a valid directory path created by platformdirs.
suggested_tests.code_snippet:
def test_cache_dir_platformdirs():
    from linkwatch.cache import cache_dir
    path = cache_dir()
    assert os.path.exists(path)
    assert 'linkwatch' in path
